newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower in active trade.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 3.05 lower at 1,035.55 in active trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
"There was a lot of speculation because of rumors about a large buyer (of dollars)," one trader said, adding however that no single buyer was responsible for the U.S. currency's trend upward.

Dealers said there was scattered selling of dollars by exporters but not enough to hold the peso at its intraday high of 1,031.40. They reported 304 trades for a total of $129 million and said the peso closed at its session low.
